name: ollama
description: Ollama on your own machine: generate, chat and embed (non-streaming), list, show, pull, copy and delete local models

nodes.title: Generate
nodes.description: Complete a prompt with a local model (not streamed); the text is in response

model.description: Local model name, e.g. llama3.2 or qwen3:8b (see list_models)

suffix.description: Text after the completion (fill in the middle)

raw.description: Send the prompt without the model's template

format.description: JSON schema the output must follow, e.g. {"type":"object","properties":{...}}

think.description: Thinking models: true/false, or a level "low" | "medium" | "high" (gpt-oss); thinking is returned separately

keep_alive.description: How long the model stays loaded, e.g. "5m", "1h" or "0"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
